name: CT (computed tomography)
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "A fast 3D X-ray that shows the size and shape of tumours and whether they have spread."
fields.after: "A CT scan is a fast 3D X-ray that shows the size and shape of tumours and whether they have spread."

fields.before: "Rotating X-ray source and detector; attenuation reconstructed into cross-sectional images. Iodinated contrast highlights vasculature."
fields.after: "A rotating X-ray source and detector measure attenuation, which is reconstructed into cross-sectional images. Iodinated contrast highlights vasculature."
